name: Shrouded Master Scholar Archetype
body:
While most scholars follow traditional courses of study, a few delve into fields considered forbidden. These “shrouded masters” often operate in secrecy, dwelling in the dark corners of society where they familiarize themselves with aberrations, occult rituals, and all manner of strange phenomena.

Class Skills

Stealth (Dex) is a class skill for you, but Diplomacy (Cha) is not.

This feature modifies class skills.

Dark Studies

You cannot choose from the studies of Geography, Heraldry, Horticulture, or Jurisprudence. Instead, you gain access to the Dark Arts, Occultism, and Parapsychology studies (see below), which are only available to shrouded masters.

This feature modifies scholar studies.

Inspired Subterfuge

Beginning at 3rd level, you can use inspiration for free with the Stealth skill, as well as when using the Bluff skill to deceive someone with a lie.

This feature replaces the basic study ability normally gained at 3rd level.
